# Escorpio

> Escorpio is a USDG money desk on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663). It compares Morpho vault rates and Morpho loans
> against stock tokens, then lets people deposit, withdraw, borrow and repay from their own wallet. Escorpio never
> holds funds and has no smart contract of its own. Nothing it shows is financial advice.

## MCP server

Add `https://escorpio.pro/mcp` as a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no key, no login). Tools read or prepare;
none can sign, send or approve:

- `get_best_rates`: best open USDG vault, cheapest loan per collateral, widest rate gap
- `list_vaults`: USDG vaults, best net rate first (`open_only`, `limit`)
- `list_markets`: USDG loan markets, cheapest first (`collateral`, `limit`)
- `explain_risk_notes`: what every risk note means
- `prepare_deposit` (vault, amount_usdg, wallet?): A deposit into one vault, checked and (with wallet) simulated. Returns open_url: escorpio.pro with the form filled in.
- `prepare_withdraw` (vault, amount_usdg or "all", wallet?): A withdrawal back to the wallet, checked and simulated.
- `prepare_borrow` (market_id, collateral_amount?, borrow_usdg?, wallet?): Collateral in and/or a USDG loan. Refused past 90% of the liquidation line. With wallet: loan after, liquidation price, steps, simulation.
- `prepare_repay` (market_id, amount_usdg or "all", wallet?): A repayment, checked and simulated.
- `prepare_collateral_withdraw` (market_id, collateral_amount, wallet?): Collateral back to the wallet, refused if the loan would pass the 90% limit.
- `prepare_payment_request` (amount_usdg, memo?, valid_days?): A USDG invoice: a link to /receive that the payee opens and signs.
- `check_payment` (tx_hash, payment_link?): A payment read from the chain, and whether it paid that request.

Quote `readAt` with any rate. Never call a rate safe or guaranteed. To act, use a prepare tool: it returns `open_url`,
escorpio.pro with the form filled in, where the wallet owner checks the plan and signs. Say what the link does before
giving it, and never say money moved until `check_payment` or the explorer shows it.

Hermes Agent: add it under `mcp_servers` in `~/.hermes/config.yaml`, then `/reload-mcp`:

```yaml
mcp_servers:
  escorpio:
    url: "https://escorpio.pro/mcp"
```

## Agent skill

The same desk as an Agent Skill (SKILL.md), with the rules for answering: size, risk notes and read time with every
rate, no advice. Source: https://github.com/escorpio-dev/escorpio-app/tree/main/skills/escorpio

- Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other agents: `npx skills add escorpio-dev/escorpio-app` (listed on skills.sh)
- Hermes Agent: `hermes skills install escorpio-dev/escorpio-app/skills/escorpio`

## Public API

OpenAPI description: [openapi.json](https://escorpio.pro/openapi.json). Setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Hermes Agent and the skills CLI: [docs](https://escorpio.pro/docs)


Calls are counted for https://escorpio.pro/stats: which endpoint or MCP tool, and the app name an MCP client sends; no IP,
no request contents. No key, no login. JSON, open to any origin. Each reading is at most one minute old and says when it was read
(`readAt`). Rates are percent per year, money is US dollars.

- [GET /api/rates](https://escorpio.pro/api/rates): best open USDG vault, cheapest loan per collateral, widest rate gap
- [GET /api/vaults](https://escorpio.pro/api/vaults): every USDG vault, best net rate first; `?open=1` for open ones only
- [GET /api/markets](https://escorpio.pro/api/markets): every USDG loan market, cheapest first; `?collateral=<address or symbol>`
- [GET /api/desk](https://escorpio.pro/api/desk): the raw Morpho answer the site reads, unchanged

Every vault and market carries `notes`: risk notes in plain words. A note with `"stop": true` is a reason not to use
it right now. No note does not mean safe.

## Pages

- [Home](https://escorpio.pro/): how much idle USDG would earn at today's best open vault rate
- [Earn](https://escorpio.pro/earn): every USDG vault, deposit and withdraw
- [Borrow](https://escorpio.pro/borrow): every USDG loan market per collateral, borrow and repay
- [Method](https://escorpio.pro/method): where every number comes from and what each risk note means

- Morpho Blue: 0x9D53d5E3bd5E8d4Cbfa6DB1ca238AEA02E651010
